title: Coffee Shop Vocabulary
summary: Order a caramel latte on a rainy day: aroma, barista, stirrer.
script:
Today, you’ll order and enjoy a delicious coffee.
Imagine it’s a rainy day, and to take shelter from the rain, you step into a cozy coffee shop.
The coffee shop has a wonderful aroma.
Aroma means a pleasant smell. Mmm. (Sniffing)
You get in line and order a caramel latte.
Notice how caramel is pronounced: (car-mul) or  (care-uh-mel). And notice how latte is pronounced: (lah-tay).
A latte is espresso mixed with a lot of hot milk.
And you can hear the barista preparing your latte.
A barista is a person who makes and serves coffee at a coffee shop.
Listen. You can hear the coffee machine making your espresso.
And now, you can hear the barista pouring hot milk into the cup.
Finally, he adds a pump of caramel and hands you the cup.
You slowly walk over to another counter and grab a stirrer.
A stirrer is a small stick used to stir or mix coffee, especially after adding sugar, milk, or cream.
You also grab a packet of sugar and add some sugar to your latte.
You stir your coffee, and now you’re ready to drink it.
Your body starts to feel warmer and more relaxed.
You don’t feel cold anymore.
Your body feels warm and comfortable as you enjoy the comforting taste of your coffee.
Enjoy it!
